title: 基石资产管理（香港）梁：腾讯12倍市盈率更具价值，AI芯片股PB已超历史
speaker: Michael Liang

segments.en: Talk to us as well about what looks good on the AI chain if we are looking a bit more near term before we see the wobbles.
segments.zh: 也谈谈在AI链条上，在波动出现前，短期什么看起来不错？

segments.en: We are value investors I tend to look at valuations a lot more than forecast of earnings because there's a highly uncertain sometimes.
segments.zh: 我们是价值投资者，我更看重估值而非盈利预测，因为后者高度不确定。

segments.en: If you look at in terms of PBs right I mean I think memory business is a cyclical business although everybody's saying today is not I doubt seriously doubt that's the case.
segments.zh: 从市净率看，存储业务是周期性的，尽管现在大家都说不是，我严重怀疑。

segments.en: In terms of PE memory stocks are very cheap but in terms of PB they're very expensive they're like four standard deviation above historical.
segments.zh: 从市盈率看存储很便宜，但从市净率看非常贵，比历史均值高出四个标准差。

segments.en: Even higher on the country you have company like Tencent it's in a 12 times earnings.
segments.zh: 甚至更高，而像腾讯这样的公司只有12倍市盈率。

segments.en: That cash flow to me is very much I can't say it's certain about with a hard degree of certainty with a 12 times earnings I find value in that kind of business.
segments.zh: 其现金流，我不能说完全确定，但12倍市盈率下，我在这种业务中看到了价值。

segments.en: Rather than paying you know something way into the future you see some correction in the Asia tax stocks today because they are kind of all beta play nowadays.
segments.zh: 而不是为遥远的未来买单。今天亚洲科技股回调，因为它们现在都是贝塔博弈。

segments.en: You've seen a 10% moving up and down in a day seem to be normal that cannot be normal as we know.
segments.zh: 一天涨跌10%似乎成了常态，这不正常。

segments.en: I've been doing this for 30 years that's just not normal so I feel there's a you know they have a reckoning it's upon us.
segments.zh: 我做了30年，这根本不正常，所以我觉得清算就在眼前。

segments.en: You said software in the US looks cheap right now I mean before this there was all this kind of concerns about disruption right.
segments.zh: 你说美国软件现在看起来便宜，之前大家都担心颠覆。

segments.en: That you know AI was going to take over some of these software companies and eventually I displaced them are you not thinking that as well?
segments.zh: AI会接管一些软件公司并最终取代它们，你不这么认为吗？

segments.en: Not anymore at the beginning yes we have no idea how the AI going to work out but now I increasingly I try to implement we try to implement AI into our own workflow.
segments.zh: 现在不了。一开始我们也不知道AI会如何发展，但现在我们越来越多地在工作流中实施AI。
